methods.label: Use the infinite geometric sum
methods.explanation:
Each term is the preceding term multiplied by
\[
q=\frac{-8/3}{4}=-\frac23.
\]
Since \(|q|=2/3<1\), the series converges. An infinite geometric series with first term \(A\) and ratio \(q\), where \(|q|<1\), has sum \(A/(1-q)\). Hence
\[
s=\frac4{1-(-2/3)}
=\frac4{5/3}
=\frac{12}{5}
=\boxed{2.4},
\]
which is choice B.
